methodologyNotes: This dataset covers 12 desktop PC motherboards across AMD AM5 (B650/B650E/X670E/B850) and Intel LGA1700 (B760/Z790) platforms, targeting the most-searched models in 2022-2025. Specifications were independently re-verified against official manufacturer product pages (ASUS/ROG, MSI, Gigabyte/AORUS, ASRock), major retailer listings (Newegg, Best Buy, Amazon, Micro Center), and review sources (Tom's Hardware, PCWorld, PC Gamer, Vortez, OC3D, FPS Review). Prices reflect US launch MSRP or the documented launch list/street price where a separate manufacturer MSRP was not stated. Booleans indicate presence (true) or absence (false) of a feature. The pcie_5 boolean is true when the board exposes ANY PCIe 5.0 interface (GPU x16 and/or an M.2 Gen5 slot); note that several B650 (non-E) boards expose PCIe 5.0 only on an M.2 slot while the GPU x16 runs at PCIe 4.0 -- provenance specifies which. m2_slots counts storage M.2 slots only (not Key-E WiFi sockets). accessedAt 2026-06-19. Adversarial fact-check correction: Gigabyte B650 Aorus Elite AX price corrected and its 'PCIe 5.0 x16 slot' provenance claim corrected (this B650 board's GPU slot is PCIe 4.0; PCIe 5.0 is present only on one M.2 slot).

products.name: ROG Strix B650E-F Gaming WiFi
products.priceNote: Launch/list price (~$289-299); street price has dropped significantly
products.provenance: Re-verified: Socket AM5, B650E chipset, ATX, DDR5, 3x M.2 (1x PCIe 5.0 x4 + 2x PCIe 4.0 x4), PCIe 5.0 x16 GPU slot (B650E provides Gen5 GPU lanes), Wi-Fi 6E, 12+2 power stages confirmed via ROG official spec page and Amazon listing. Launch list price ~$289-299 (Amazon price history avg ~$278; highest $437 in 2023). priceUsd 299.99 retained as launch/list.

products.name: ROG Strix X670E-E Gaming WiFi
products.provenance: Re-verified: Socket AM5, X670E chipset, ATX, DDR5, 4x M.2 (3x PCIe 5.0 x4 + 1x PCIe 4.0 x4), 18+2 power stages, Wi-Fi 6E confirmed via ASUS spec page and Amazon. Launch MSRP $499 corroborated by multiple 2022 reviews (XDA, Guru3D, Custom PC) noting the high $499 price point. ASUS spec URL is geo-redirected from outside the US but is real and topical.

products.name: MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch; street price now lower
products.provenance: Re-verified: Socket AM5, B650 (non-E) chipset, ATX, DDR5, 3x M.2 all PCIe 4.0, Wi-Fi 6E confirmed via PCWorld review, MSI spec page and Amazon. B650 does not expose PCIe 5.0 lanes (GPU x16 is PCIe 4.0, no Gen5 M.2), so pcie_5 false. MSRP $259.99 per PCWorld.

products.name: B650 Aorus Elite AX
products.provenance: CORRECTED: Socket AM5, B650 chipset, ATX, DDR5, 3x M.2 (1x PCIe 5.0 x4 CPU-connected + 2x PCIe 4.0 x4), Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax). As a B650 (non-E) board the main GPU x16 slot is PCIe 4.0, NOT PCIe 5.0 -- Vortez review and Gigabyte spec confirm 'eschews PCIe 5.0 GPU signalling in favour of PCIe 4.0'. pcie_5 remains true because one M.2 slot is PCIe 5.0 x4 (feature present). Draft's claim of a 'PCIe 5.0 x16 slot' was false and has been removed. Launch/street price $229.99 (Vortez, Best Buy), corrected from draft's $219.99.

products.name: B650E Steel Legend WiFi
products.provenance: Re-verified via official ASRock page: B650E chipset (PCIe 5.0 x16 GPU slot + PCIe Gen5x4 M.2 confirm the 'E'), AM5, ATX, DDR5, 3x M.2 (1x PCIe Gen5x4 + 2x PCIe Gen4x4), Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax), Bluetooth 5.2. Newegg title's 'Dual M.2' is a retailer data error; ASRock official page confirms 3 slots. Launch list price ~$269.99. Corroboration switched from TechReviewer aggregator to Newegg official listing.

products.name: TUF Gaming B760-Plus WiFi
products.priceNote: Launch list price (DDR5 variant); ~$235 at review time

This is the DDR5 variant. Release 2023 (B760 launched Jan 2023). priceUsd 229.99 retained as launch list (~$235-250 at review time). Source switched from Newegg to ASUS official techspec page.
